recordingMethod: Chromium 151 CSS-pixel capture of forty-eight independent inert replays, split into ordinary and top-BREAK 24-case executions (local/opponent x active/sole bench x original clean group q1/q2/q3 x same middle/base lower card selected twice), against the checked-in board surface. Construction and the first divergent lower-card single are inherited from a digest-pinned dependency; keyboard and clicked-card ingress are digest-pinned but not executed. The application module is stubbed, and only the immediate same-card follow-up single=true transition is retained as the measured transition.

included: forty-eight independently constructed marker-free histories, executed as separate ordinary and top-BREAK 24-case captures

local/opponent active and sole-bench histories beginning from an unrefreshed clean top-driven group q1/q2/q3 state, followed by a first middle/base single=true reset and an immediate same-selected follow-up
exact pre-state inheritance from the matching compound-lower-nonzero-group-single-v1 post-state, including turns, BREAK flags, margins, stack/card rectangles, and ten hit probes
the measured q0-to-q1, false-to-true single-card branch mutating only the selected lower evolution while the top and other lower card retain their divergent state
the q2 parity collision: active pre/post geometry and bench post geometry equal the matching homogeneous history-authored-q0 case; BREAK flags also coincide, while turns and full setup traces differ
digest-pinned active/bench Alt-R ingress and clicked-image-to-zone/index selection, without executing the application keydown listener
complete operation and measured-transition traces, margins, topology and links, painted/authored/physical geometry, ten native hit probes, stable identifiers, observer ownership, and cleanup
excluded: pristine group-q0, homogeneous returned-q0, and homogeneous history-authored-q0 lower-card Alt-R
q1-refreshed or lower-initiated nonzero-group entry; every included original q1 history is the unrefreshed clean top-driven transition
a different middle/base follow-up target, third or later lower-card single actions, mixed initiators, and already-BREAK or raw/imported selected q0 states
group rotation, refresh, movement, promotion, evolution/removal, leaveAll, undo, or replay after the first divergent lower-card transition
normalizing divergent lower-card rotation, BREAK flags, or wrapper-margin history into canonical v2 state, commands, rendering, or UX
converted categories, non-Pokemon initiators, Energy, Trainer, Tool, markers/counters, attachments, mixed dimensions, and noncanonical assets
additional bench siblings, flex shrink, overflow, resize-driven layout, explicit flip, fullscreen, alternate viewport/DPR, and concealment
application/network execution, candidate parity, and production/domain/protocol/schema geometry
